entities.name: Trenz
entities.description: A white-haired Izzet chemister from Ravnica who performed an epic experiment for Niv-Mizzet.

entities.name: Niv-Mizzet
entities.description: Dragon leader of the Izzet League, for whom Trenz performed his experiment.

entities.name: Izzet League
entities.description: The Ravnican guild of chemisters to which Trenz belongs.

entities.name: Mr. Taz
entities.description: A figure Trenz teleported next to in the Undercity.

entities.name: Krenko
entities.description: A figure Trenz teleported next to in the Undercity, together with Mr. Taz.

entities.name: Cult of Rakdos
entities.description: Ravnican cult whose Bloodwitches took notice of the destruction and created a new feast day.

entities.name: Ravnica
entities.description: The plane where Trenz lives and works.

entities.name: Undercity
entities.description: The bowels of Ravnica where Trenz was teleported.

entities.name: Empty Cup Row
entities.description: An abandoned block cleared of rubble by Trenz's first test.

entities.name: Rix Maadi
entities.description: Location of the Rakdos pleasure clubs where Bloodwitches nested.

entities.name: Experiment Day
entities.description: The day on which Trenz ran four tests involving magic, science and luck.

events.summary: Trenz sets up his equipment on Experiment Day for four tests.
events.quote: On Experiment Day, Trenz set up his equipment to run a series of tests involving magic, science, and sheer luck.

events.summary: The first test tears a Cyclonic Rift through the Empty Cup Row, clearing rubble.
events.quote: This created a Cyclonic Rift that tore through the abandoned block called the Empty Cup Row

events.summary: The second test accidentally teleports Trenz next to Mr. Taz and Krenko in the Undercity, giving them access to the Orzhov inner sanctum.
events.quote: Trenz inhaled too much dust and accidentally received a teleportal to the bowels of the Undercity just next to Mr. Taz and Krenko

events.summary: The third test triggers Mizzium Mortars; the destruction draws the Rakdos Bloodwitches, who create a new feast day.
events.quote: In the aftermath, the Cult created a new feast day

events.summary: Trenz tests the Neural Schisatrode and the room erupts in lightning.
events.quote: Lastly, Trenz tested the Neural Schisatrode.

relations.note: Performed an epic experiment for him.
relations.quote: who performed an epic experiment for Niv-Mizzet
Trenz is a white-haired Izzet chemister
